title: Cross-renderer conformance transcript and qualification rule
summary: Renderer agreement is tested through a canonical semantic input and normalized transcript. Web, Swing, GTK/Direct Linux and Android are not marked conformant merely because their documentation sounds aligned.
required_transcript_semantics: exact definition acceptance by definitionId@version/content address
exact published ResourceRef requirement with no definition-supplied URL/copy
stable collection identity independent of native row position
UI_ACTION carrying event-time renderedRevision and, when workspace-bound, exact opaque workspaceContext
semantic activation without native input synthesis
positive-list observation subscription and authorised observation emission
deauthorisation or other semantic faults fail closed/request resynchronisation
qualification_rule: PASS requires a real renderer adapter to consume the canonical fixture, emit only normalized semantic operations, and match the canonical transcript. Reference-adapter self-tests prove the kit, not renderer conformance.

current_evidence.web: Current integration evidence uses Alchemy Wire UI JS v0.4-dev6; a separately qualified dev7 line exists but is not substituted silently for application-specific integration evidence.
current_evidence.swing: wire_ui_swing_v0.2-dev11.zip; presentation-only dev11 over retained dev10 semantic baseline.
current_evidence.gtk_direct_linux: wire_direct_linux_v0.1-dev38.zip archive; semantic proxy/range-demand evidence present, with internal VERSION/README metadata drift recorded as missing work.
current_evidence.android: Renderer convergence evidence remains the documented Android dev7 semantic checkpoint; resident ooRexx native host tooling has separately advanced to dev16 and is not mislabeled as renderer dev16.
